sentences.text:
. This is an appeal under section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 against an award dated 15.09.2008 filed on claim petition 19/CP by the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Kathua whereby the appellant herein came to be burdened with payment of compensation of an amount of Rs.
1,18,200/- for the death of the son of the respondents.
The alleged motor vehicle accident is said to have taken place by reference to vehicle Truck no. JKQ-2581 which is alleged to be belonging to the appellant.

2. However, the appellant in his memo of appeal has pleaded that at no point of time he was owner of the truck and in this regard relies upon a purported certificate of the Regional Transport Officer,
Jammu annexed as annexure-B which is to the effect that the ownership of the truck JKQ-2581 Model no. 985 was in the name of Nanak Singh S/o Lal Singh R/o Hari Singh High Street, Srinagar which came to be transferred on 05.04.1988 in the name Arvinder Singh S/o Nanak Singh R/o B. C.
Road, Jammu and lastly in the name of Sukhdev Singh S/o Mehar Singh R/o Batote.
3.
However, this certificate is not bearing any number and date of the office of the Regional Transport Officer, Jammu.
4. This Court cannot take cognizance of this certificate as it is unless and until it is duly confirmed by the office of the Regional Transport Officer, Jammu in terms of number and date.
